description: Source code for a CFF token stream parser, part of the FreeType project, handling font data parsing including integers, reals, font matrices, bounding boxes, and dictionary entries.

methods.name: cff_parse_integer
methods.description: Parses an integer value from a byte stream based on CFF encoding rules.

methods.name: cff_parse_real
methods.description: Parses a real (floating point) number from a byte stream, handling various formats and scaling.

methods.name: cff_parse_num
methods.description: Reads either an integer or real number from a byte stream.

methods.name: do_fixed
methods.description: Converts a number from byte stream to fixed-point representation, scaled as needed.

methods.name: cff_parse_fixed
methods.description: Reads a fixed-point number from a byte stream.

methods.name: cff_parse_fixed_scaled
methods.description: Reads a scaled fixed-point number from a byte stream.

methods.name: cff_parse_fixed_dynamic
methods.description: Reads a precise fixed-point number with dynamic scaling from a byte stream.

methods.name: cff_parse_font_matrix
methods.description: Parses font transformation matrix from the stack into font dictionary.

methods.name: cff_parse_font_bbox
methods.description: Parses font bounding box from the stack into font dictionary.

methods.name: cff_parse_private_dict
methods.description: Parses private dictionary entries from the stack.

methods.name: cff_parse_cid_ros
methods.description: Parses CID registry, ordering, and supplement info.

methods.name: cff_parser_run
methods.description: Executes the parsing of a CFF token stream from start to limit.
